```{=html}
  <section class="report-section country-research-section" aria-labelledby="culture-heading">
    <div class="insight-card culture-panel">
      <h2 id="culture-heading">Culture, behavior, and the burden of CVD</h2>
      <p>
        The most important statistical point is that absolute deaths and death rates tell different stories. China and India show very
        large total CVD burdens because of their large populations, while Russia has a much higher CVD death rate per capita than
        the United States. These differences suggest that public health risk is shaped not only by population size, but also by diet,
        smoking, activity patterns, hypertension, alcohol use, healthcare access, and broader social conditions.
      </p>

      <div class="country-table-wrap">
        <table class="country-burden-table" aria-label="Cardiovascular disease deaths, rates, and related risk factors in four countries">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Country</th>
              <th scope="col">CVD deaths</th>
              <th scope="col">Deaths per 100,000</th>
              <th scope="col">Key cultural / risk factors</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <th scope="row">China</th>
              <td>5.02 million</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>High sodium intake, urban dietary transition, sedentary lifestyles, tobacco use, rising hypertension.</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th scope="row">India</th>
              <td>2.86 million</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>Dietary transition, tobacco exposure, low physical activity, urbanization, unequal access to prevention.</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th scope="row">Russia</th>
              <td>903,200</td>
              <td>622.5</td>
              <td>Tobacco use, alcohol consumption, hypertension, diet, physical inactivity, socioeconomic deprivation.</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th scope="row">United States</th>
              <td>920,884</td>
              <td>273.3</td>
              <td>Obesity, high blood pressure, diabetes, smoking, physical inactivity, processed food patterns.</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div class="country-briefs">
        <article class="country-brief">
          <h3>China</h3>
          <p>China had approximately 5.02 million CVD deaths in 2021, the largest number among individual countries in the WHO dataset. Stroke followed by ischemic heart disease remained major drivers of mortality.</p>
          <ul>
            <li>About 27.3% of adults aged 30–79 had hypertension in 2019.</li>
            <li>About 23.1% of adults aged 15+ used tobacco in 2022.</li>
            <li>Urbanization and dietary change have been linked to higher sodium intake and more sedentary behavior.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
        <article class="country-brief">
          <h3>India</h3>
          <p>India had approximately 2.86 million CVD deaths in 2021, with a major burden concentrated among people aged 40–69. This indicates that risk is shaped by both environmental exposure and social conditions.</p>
          <ul>
            <li>About 220 million people were estimated to have hypertension.</li>
            <li>Only about 12% of people with hypertension had blood pressure under control.</li>
            <li>WHO highlights unhealthy diet, tobacco, alcohol, low physical activity, and rapid urbanization as major drivers.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
        <article class="country-brief">
          <h3>Russia</h3>
          <p>Russia had 903,200 CVD deaths in 2021, with a rate of 622.5 per 100,000, far above the U.S. rate of 273.3. This suggests a different epidemiologic profile, shaped by behavioral risks and healthcare access.</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Tobacco, alcohol, and hypertension are major contributors.</li>
            <li>Diet and physical inactivity are also important factors.</li>
            <li>WHO's European analysis links CVD risk to socioeconomic deprivation, air pollution, and weak prevention.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
        <article class="country-brief">
          <h3>United States</h3>
          <p>The United States had 920,884 CVD deaths in 2021, with a rate of 273.3 per 100,000. The burden remains very large even though the rate is lower than Russia's, reflecting a high-risk population with persistent obesity, diabetes, and vascular disease.</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Obesity, smoking, hypertension, and diabetes remain core drivers.</li>
            <li>Dietary patterns high in sodium, saturated fat, and processed foods strongly contribute.</li>
            <li>Healthcare access and prevention quality influence how effectively risk is managed.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
      </div>

      <aside class="research-model-note">
        A more precise research model would not claim that "culture itself causes CVD." Instead, it would analyze how cultural and environmental factors shape measurable behavior and physiological risk factors such as diet, smoking, physical inactivity, hypertension, and obesity, which then influence cardiovascular outcomes.
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="methodology-grid">
    <section class="methodology-card" aria-labelledby="methodology-heading">
      <h2 id="methodology-heading">Methodology</h2>
      <p>Values represent age-standardized cardiovascular disease death rates per 100,000 population, both sexes combined, as reported in the World Heart Observatory dataset.</p>
    </section>
    <section class="methodology-card" aria-labelledby="interpretation-heading">
      <h2 id="interpretation-heading">Interpretation</h2>
      <p>Darker regions indicate a higher burden of CVD mortality. The map supports zoom, pan, and hover inspection for detailed country-level comparisons.</p>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section class="glossary-panel" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading">
    <h2 id="glossary-heading">Common CVD terms explained</h2>
    <p>These terms are frequently used in cardiovascular disease research and public health discussions. They help explain how risk, disease progression, and mortality are measured.</p>
    <dl class="glossary-list">
      <div><dt>Cardiovascular disease (CVD)</dt><dd>A group of disorders affecting the heart and blood vessels.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Coronary heart disease</dt><dd>A condition involving narrowed or blocked blood vessels that supply the heart.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Stroke</dt><dd>Brain injury caused when blood flow is blocked or a blood vessel bleeds.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Hypertension</dt><dd>Persistently elevated blood pressure, which increases strain on the heart and vessels.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Age-standardized mortality rate</dt><dd>A death rate adjusted to a common age distribution so populations can be compared more fairly.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Risk factor</dt><dd>A behavior or condition associated with a higher likelihood of disease; association alone does not prove causation.</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </section>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7"></script>
<script>
  const statusNode = document.getElementById('map-status');
  const mapCountryName = document.getElementById('map-country-name');
  const mapCountryRate = document.getElementById('map-country-rate');
  const mapCountryNote = document.getElementById('map-country-note');

  function updateMapStat(countryName, valueText, noteText) {
    mapCountryName.textContent = countryName || 'Global overview';
    mapCountryRate.textContent = valueText || 'Age-standardized mortality';
    mapCountryNote.textContent = noteText || 'Hover or focus a country to view its country-level cardiovascular disease burden.';
  }

  const normalizeName = (value) =>
    (value || '')
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/&/g, 'and')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();

  const aliasNames = {
    'cote d ivoire': 'Cote d Ivoire',
    'congo kinshasa': 'Congo - Kinshasa',
    'congo brazzaville': 'Congo - Brazzaville',
    'vatican city': 'Vatican City',
    'saint lucia': 'St. Lucia',
    'saint vincent and the grenadines': 'St. Vincent & Grenadines',
    'saint kitts and nevis': 'St. Kitts & Nevis',
    'saint pierre and miquelon': 'St. Pierre & Miquelon',
    'saint helena': 'St. Helena',
    'united states of america': 'United States',
    'united kingdom': 'United Kingdom',
    'north macedonia': 'North Macedonia',
    'myanmar': 'Myanmar (Burma)',
    'myanmar burma': 'Myanmar (Burma)',
    'eswatini': 'Eswatini',
    'sao tome and principe': 'São Tomé & Príncipe',
    'palestinian territories': 'Palestinian Territories',
    'cape verde': 'Cape Verde',
    'czech republic': 'Czechia',
    'bahamas': 'Bahamas',
    'dominican republic': 'Dominican Republic',
    'guinea bissau': 'Guinea-Bissau',
    'antigua and barbuda': 'Antigua & Barbuda',
    'barbados': 'Barbados',
    'grenada': 'Grenada',
    'tanzania': 'Tanzania',
    'timor leste': 'Timor-Leste',
    'trinidad and tobago': 'Trinidad & Tobago',
    'united states virgin islands': 'U.S. Virgin Islands',
    'us virgin islands': 'U.S. Virgin Islands',
    'northern mariana islands': 'Northern Mariana Islands',
    'guam': 'Guam',
    'marshall islands': 'Marshall Islands',
    'bahrain': 'Bahrain',
    'singapore': 'Singapore',
    'maldives': 'Maldives',
    'andorra': 'Andorra',
    'tonga': 'Tonga',
    'bermuda': 'Bermuda',
    'malta': 'Malta',
    'mauritius': 'Mauritius',
    'kiribati': 'Kiribati',
    'seychelles': 'Seychelles',
    'comoros': 'Comoros',
    'samoa': 'Samoa',
    'serbia': 'Serbia',
    'russian federation': 'Russia'
  };

  function updateStatus(countryName, valueText, confidenceRange) {
    const detail = valueText
      ? `${countryName}: ${valueText} age-standardized deaths per 100,000 people. 95% confidence range: ${confidenceRange}.`
      : `${countryName}: no data available.`;
    statusNode.textContent = detail;
  }

  function showCountry(country) {
    const rate = Number(country.value).toFixed(1);
    const lower = Number(country.lower);
    const upper = Number(country.upper);
    const confidenceRange = Number.isFinite(lower) && Number.isFinite(upper)
      ? `${lower.toFixed(1)} to ${upper.toFixed(1)}`
      : 'not available';

    updateStatus(country.country_name, rate, confidenceRange);
    updateMapStat(
      country.country_name,
      `${rate} per 100,000`,
      `95% confidence range: ${confidenceRange} per 100,000 people.`
    );
  }

  async function loadData() {
    const [geoResponse, countryResponse, alpha3Response] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holtzy/D3-graph-gallery/master/DATA/world.geojson'),
      fetch('data/world-heart-map-data.json'),
      fetch('data/country-alpha3-alpha2.json')
    ]);

    const world = await geoResponse.json();
    const payload = await countryResponse.json();
    const alpha3Map = await alpha3Response.json();

    const alpha3ToCountryCode = new Map(
      Object.entries(alpha3Map || {}).map(([alpha3, alpha2]) => [String(alpha3).toUpperCase(), String(alpha2).toUpperCase()])
    );

    return { world, countries: payload.data || [], alpha3ToCountryCode };
  }

  function resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode) {
    const named = feature?.properties?.name;
    const key = normalizeName(named);
    const direct = countryByName.get(key) || countryByName.get(aliasNames[key] ? normalizeName(aliasNames[key]) : key);
    if (direct) return direct;

    const iso3 = String(feature?.id || '').toUpperCase();
    const iso2 = alpha3ToCountryCode.get(iso3) || null;
    if (iso2) return countryByCode.get(iso2) || null;

    return null;
  }

  loadData()
    .then(({ world, countries, alpha3ToCountryCode }) => {
      const countryByName = new Map();
      const countryByCode = new Map();

      countries.forEach((entry) => {
        const key = normalizeName(entry.country_name);
        const aliasKey = normalizeName(aliasNames[key] || entry.country_name);
        countryByName.set(key, entry);
        countryByName.set(aliasKey, entry);
        countryByCode.set(String(entry.country_code || '').toUpperCase(), entry);
      });

      const min = d3.min(countries, (d) => Number(d.value));
      const max = d3.max(countries, (d) => Number(d.value));

      const colorScale = d3
        .scaleSequential()
        .domain([min, max])
        .interpolator(d3.interpolateRgbBasis(['#e6f0fb', '#9bbdf0', '#4b86d6', '#174d9c']));

      const svg = d3.select('#world-map');
      const featureCollection = {
        type: 'FeatureCollection',
        features: world.features.filter((feature) => feature.properties?.name && feature.properties.name !== 'Antarctica')
      };

      const projection = d3.geoMercator().fitSize([960, 500], featureCollection);
      const path = d3.geoPath(projection);
      const zoom = d3.zoom()
        .scaleExtent([1, 8])
        .on('zoom', (event) => {
          mapRoot.attr('transform', event.transform);
        });

      const mapRoot = svg.append('g').attr('class', 'map-root');
      svg.call(zoom);

      mapRoot.selectAll('path.country-path')
        .data(featureCollection.features)
        .join('path')
        .attr('class', 'country-path')
        .attr('d', path)
        .attr('fill', (feature) => {
          const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
          return country ? colorScale(Number(country.value)) : '#dfe2e6';
        })
        .attr('stroke', '#f5f7fa')
        .attr('stroke-width', 0.75)
        .attr('tabindex', (feature) => {
          const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
          return country ? 0 : -1;
        })
        .attr('role', 'button')
        .attr('aria-label', (feature) => {
          const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
          if (!country) return `${feature.properties.name}: no data available.`;
          return `${country.country_name}: ${Number(country.value).toFixed(2)} age-standardized deaths per 100,000 people.`;
        })
        .on('mouseenter', function (event, feature) {
          const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
          if (!country) return;
          showCountry(country);
          this.style.filter = 'brightness(0.96)';
        })
        .on('mouseleave', function () {
          this.style.filter = 'none';
          statusNode.textContent = 'Country data ready.';
          updateMapStat('Global overview', 'Age-standardized mortality', 'Hover or focus a country to view its country-level cardiovascular disease burden.');
        })
        .on('focus', function (event, feature) {
          const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
          if (!country) return;
          showCountry(country);
        })
        .on('blur', function () {
          statusNode.textContent = 'Country data ready.';
          updateMapStat('Global overview', 'Age-standardized mortality', 'Hover or focus a country to view its country-level cardiovascular disease burden.');
        })
        .on('keydown', function (event, feature) {
          if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
            event.preventDefault();
            const country = resolveCountry(feature, countryByName, countryByCode, alpha3ToCountryCode);
            if (country) showCountry(country);
          }
        });

      document.getElementById('zoom-in').addEventListener('click', () => {
        svg.transition().duration(250).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1.5);
      });

      document.getElementById('zoom-out').addEventListener('click', () => {
        svg.transition().duration(250).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1 / 1.5);
      });

      document.getElementById('reset-view').addEventListener('click', () => {
        svg.transition().duration(350).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);
      });

      statusNode.textContent = 'Country data ready.';
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error('Map data could not be loaded:', error);
      statusNode.textContent = 'Map data failed to load.';
    });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const predictorConfig = {
      Tobacco: { label: 'Tobacco use (%)', key: 'Tobacco' },
      PhysicalInactivity: { label: 'Physical inactivity (%)', key: 'PhysicalInactivity' },
      Alcohol: { label: 'Alcohol consumption (liters per person)', key: 'Alcohol' }
    };

    const regionColors = {
      Africa: '#1d4e89',
      Asia: '#2a9d8f',
      Europe: '#e76f51',
      'North America': '#f4a261',
      Oceania: '#8ecae6',
      'South America': '#6a4c93'
    };

    const svg = document.getElementById('cvdScatter');
    const predictorSelect = document.getElementById('predictorSelect');
    const yearSelect = document.getElementById('yearSelect');
    const regionSelect = document.getElementById('regionSelect');
    const countrySelect = document.getElementById('countrySelect');
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('scatterTooltip');

    let data = [];

    function parseCSV(text) {
      const rows = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
      if (!rows.length) return [];
      const header = rows[0].split(',');
      return rows.slice(1).filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
        const values = line.split(',');
        const obj = {};
        header.forEach((key, index) => {
          obj[key.trim()] = values[index]?.trim();
        });
        return {
          Country: obj.Country,
          Year: Number(obj.Year),
          Region: obj.Region,
          Tobacco: Number(obj.Tobacco),
          PhysicalInactivity: Number(obj.PhysicalInactivity),
          Alcohol: Number(obj.Alcohol),
          CVDMortality: Number(obj.CVDMortality)
        };
      });
    }

    function populateControl(select, values, placeholder) {
      select.innerHTML = '';
      const placeholderOption = document.createElement('option');
      placeholderOption.value = placeholder;
      placeholderOption.textContent = placeholder;
      select.appendChild(placeholderOption);
      values.forEach((value) => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = value;
        option.textContent = value;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
    }

    function updateControls() {
      const years = [...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      populateControl(yearSelect, years.map(String), '2015');
      yearSelect.value = '2015';

      const regions = ['All regions', ...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Region))];
      populateControl(regionSelect, regions, 'All regions');
      regionSelect.value = 'All regions';

      const countries = ['All countries', ...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Country))].sort();
      populateControl(countrySelect, countries, 'All countries');
      countrySelect.value = 'All countries';
    }

    function getFilteredData() {
      const selectedPredictor = predictorSelect.value;
      const selectedYear = yearSelect.value;
      const selectedRegion = regionSelect.value;
      const selectedCountry = countrySelect.value;

      return data.filter((d) => {
        const yearMatch = selectedYear === '2015' ? d.Year === 2015 : d.Year === Number(selectedYear);
        const regionMatch = selectedRegion === 'All regions' || d.Region === selectedRegion;
        const countryMatch = selectedCountry === 'All countries' || d.Country === selectedCountry;
        const predictorKey = predictorConfig[selectedPredictor].key;
        return yearMatch && regionMatch && countryMatch && Number.isFinite(d[predictorKey]) && Number.isFinite(d.CVDMortality);
      });
    }

    function showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue) {
      const predictorLabel = predictorConfig[predictorSelect.value].label;
      tooltip.innerHTML = `
        <strong>${row.Country}</strong>
        ${row.Region}<br>
        Year: ${row.Year}<br>
        ${predictorLabel}: ${xValue}<br>
        CVD mortality: ${yValue} per 100,000
      `;
      tooltip.style.display = 'block';
      tooltip.style.left = `${event.clientX + 14}px`;
      tooltip.style.top = `${event.clientY + 14}px`;
    }

    function hideTooltip() {
      tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function renderChart() {
      const filtered = getFilteredData();
      const predictorKey = predictorConfig[predictorSelect.value].key;
      const width = 900;
      const height = 500;
      const margin = { top: 20, right: 25, bottom: 60, left: 75 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

      svg.innerHTML = '';

      if (!filtered.length) {
        const text = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        text.setAttribute('x', width / 2);
        text.setAttribute('y', height / 2);
        text.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        text.setAttribute('fill', '#425468');
        text.setAttribute('font-size', '16');
        text.textContent = 'No observations match the current filters.';
        svg.appendChild(text);
        return;
      }

      const xMin = Math.min(...filtered.map((d) => d[predictorKey]));
      const xMax = Math.max(...filtered.map((d) => d[predictorKey]));
      const yMin = 0;
      const yMax = Math.max(...filtered.map((d) => d.CVDMortality)) * 1.1;

      const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - xMin) / Math.max(xMax - xMin, 1e-6)) * innerWidth;
      const yScale = (value) => height - margin.bottom - ((value - yMin) / Math.max(yMax - yMin, 1e-6)) * innerHeight;

      const axisGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      const xAxis = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
      xAxis.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-axis');
      xAxis.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
      xAxis.setAttribute('x2', width - margin.right);
      xAxis.setAttribute('y1', height - margin.bottom);
      xAxis.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
      axisGroup.appendChild(xAxis);

      const yAxis = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
      yAxis.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-axis');
      yAxis.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
      yAxis.setAttribute('x2', margin.left);
      yAxis.setAttribute('y1', margin.top);
      yAxis.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
      axisGroup.appendChild(yAxis);

      for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) {
        const yTickValue = (yMax / 5) * i;
        const xGrid = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        xGrid.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-grid');
        xGrid.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
        xGrid.setAttribute('x2', width - margin.right);
        xGrid.setAttribute('y1', yScale(yTickValue));
        xGrid.setAttribute('y2', yScale(yTickValue));
        axisGroup.appendChild(xGrid);

        const yLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        yLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
        yLabel.setAttribute('x', margin.left - 12);
        yLabel.setAttribute('y', yScale(yTickValue) + 4);
        yLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');
        yLabel.textContent = Math.round(yTickValue);
        axisGroup.appendChild(yLabel);
      }

      for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) {
        const xTickValue = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) / 5) * i;
        const yGrid = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        yGrid.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-grid');
        yGrid.setAttribute('x1', xScale(xTickValue));
        yGrid.setAttribute('x2', xScale(xTickValue));
        yGrid.setAttribute('y1', margin.top);
        yGrid.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
        axisGroup.appendChild(yGrid);

        const xLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        xLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
        xLabel.setAttribute('x', xScale(xTickValue));
        xLabel.setAttribute('y', height - margin.bottom + 20);
        xLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        xLabel.textContent = Number(xTickValue).toFixed(0);
        axisGroup.appendChild(xLabel);
      }

      const xAxisLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('x', width / 2);
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('y', height - 10);
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      xAxisLabel.textContent = predictorConfig[predictorSelect.value].label;
      axisGroup.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

      const yAxisLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('x', -height / 2);
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('y', 18);
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(-90)');
      yAxisLabel.textContent = 'CVD mortality rate (per 100,000)';
      axisGroup.appendChild(yAxisLabel);
      svg.appendChild(axisGroup);

      filtered.forEach((row) => {
        const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
        const xValue = row[predictorKey];
        const yValue = row.CVDMortality;
        circle.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-dot');
        circle.setAttribute('cx', xScale(xValue));
        circle.setAttribute('cy', yScale(yValue));
        circle.setAttribute('r', 4.8);
        circle.setAttribute('fill', regionColors[row.Region] || '#3d8ad6');
        circle.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        circle.setAttribute('aria-label', `${row.Country} in ${row.Year}: ${predictorConfig[predictorSelect.value].label} ${xValue}, CVD mortality ${yValue} per 100,000`);
        circle.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue));
        circle.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
        circle.addEventListener('focus', (event) => showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue));
        circle.addEventListener('blur', hideTooltip);
        svg.appendChild(circle);
      });
    }

    predictorSelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);
    yearSelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);
    regionSelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);
    countrySelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);

    fetch('data/cvd_country_year_data.csv')
      .then((response) => response.text())
      .then((text) => {
        data = parseCSV(text);
        updateControls();
        yearSelect.value = '2015';
        renderChart();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('Scatter plot data could not be loaded:', error);
        svg.innerHTML = '<text x="450" y="250" text-anchor="middle" fill="#425468" font-size="16">Data failed to load.</text>';
      });
  })();
</script>
```
